title: Quenched Brined Ethiopian Chickpeas Shiro
description: A silky, jammy chickpea puree served over bowtie pasta with a glassy finish, prepared without onion or garlic for a satvik-friendly profile.

ingredients.name: Niter Kibbeh
ingredients.notes: Vegan version using coconut oil and spices

instructions: Boil the bowtie pasta in salted water until al dente and drain well.
Heat the ceramic tagine over low heat and melt the vegan niter kibbeh.
Whisk the shiro powder into the vegetable brine until no lumps remain.
Pour the chickpea mixture into the tagine and add the ginger paste.
Simmer the sauce on low heat for twenty minutes while stirring constantly to reach a jammy consistency.
Drizzle olive oil over the surface to create a glassy jelly texture.
Fold the cooked bowtie pasta gently into the thick chickpea sauce.
Cover the tagine for five minutes to allow the flavors to quench and meld.
Serve immediately directly from the ceramic vessel.
